items.item: (1) The English ethics paragraph from the anchor, with its links
items.how: Written from the coordinator's anchor and checked clause by clause against 07. Links: 'There is no should beyond becoming' -> README#truth-exists (kept); 'form within it' -> 07#evaluation; new 'going on is not yet an order over courses' -> 07#scope-and-order (07 §4's lead says it); 'every continuation can be affected...' -> 05#r-mutual-dependence-and-its-pace; 'nothing lies outside each one's reach along that relation' -> 07#r-the-continuation-condition-on-the-root (H7); 'ranks every widening above what it widens' -> 07#r-self-concern-and-c-under-the-condition; new 'Every way of adding up worth that counts each thing above zero' -> 07#r-widening-as-what-every-positive-weighting-ranks (H1, the plain-words form, the how-far clause carrying the theorem); new 'need not count those who depend on one' -> 07#r-derived-extent-limits (H4: 07's thesis cites §3.3 there; Clearing.center_not_derived is a witness); T8 -> 07#theses. Two departures from the anchor, both from the check: (a) 'ranks the wider course higher, so ranking by widening adds no premise beside the life's own concern' became 'ranks the wider course higher, and ranking by widening adds no premise beside the life's own concern: there, that concern already does it' — that every additive positive weighting ranks the wider higher is not why the ranking adds no premise; the self-concern theorem is (07 §4: 'Ranking by widening adds no premise beside the life's own concern: where the condition holds de se, that concern already does it, and on a finite listing widening is exactly what every additive weighting... ranks higher' — two facts joined by 'and'); (b) how-far 'the two compose directly' became 'the two results compose directly', since the clause before it is about courses without end. Everything else is the anchor word for word. H10: 'The ethics emerges from continuation' kept; after it the paragraph says what holds conditionally ('if a life holds...'), what is offered ('the one step we offer'), and the how-far clause what is proved and what is open.

The anchor's sentences replace the sixth pass's ('without time', 'courses that end', 'not stated as one theorem', 'every positive weighting', 'argued, not shown'), with '(07 §4.9)' linked to 07#what-persisting-shows and 08 §12's link kept. Checked: mutual dependence read across all steps gives the condition as each center's reach along being affected (Flow.MutuallyDependent.unrestricted, near-definitional); under it self-concern ranks every widening on a finite listing (increasingInOwn_iff_increasing_of_unrestricted) and, one way, between two level paths whose admitted pairs fit in a finite list, so that their admissions end (Web.extension_ranked_of_increasingInOwn, Web.admits_nothing_from_of_listed; 'admission decided' left at screen depth, as the sixth verifier judged); the two compose directly (07's closing paragraph: unrestricted_of_mutuallyDependent then extension_ranked_of_increasingInOwn); widens_iff_every_positive with 'additive' and 'counts each listed thing above zero' (H1). That a life forms such an order: 'not shown... a filter on what was chosen, not an order formed (07 §4.9)' (H3), 'argued' removed. Also 08 §8's second find said with 08's own word, 'the scope and order the ranking results assume, clarified' (was 'made explicit'; F7).

items.item: (1) The Chinese mirror, with the cold readers' fixes
items.how: README-ZH's 伦理 paragraph and 看到了多远 re-written in natural Chinese following the glossary's terms. Fable 1: no sentence opens on 在那里 (在关系闭合之处 / 关系闭合时). Fable 2: 依存于它的那些 (H4's Chinese verbatim: 依存若只沿一个方向，对自身延续的关切未必把依存于它的那些也算进来). Fable 3: 同时提出的，是一种看法. Fable 6 and H8: 两条进程若能用一个有限列表列全它们所容纳的（步，形成）项，因而从某一步起都不再容纳任何东西. astra 1: self-concern defined once as an ordering property ('这里把一种排序性质称为*自我关切*：凡一个进程扩大另一个、多出的东西里有属于自身延续的，就把前者排在后者之上'), then why, where relations close, it ranks every widening ('一切都在自身所能到达的范围之内', the theorem's mechanism: the marking reading the closure marks everything); no more 作为…次序来持守. astra 2 and H1: plain '凡给每样东西一个大于零的权重、再把权重相加的计法' in the paragraph and H1's exact '凡给每个所列之物一个大于零的权重、再把权重相加的计法' in how-far. astra 3 and H7: '沿“受影响”这一关系，从每个中心都能到达一切'; '若把从一个立场看有意义的，读作该立场之中心所能到达的范围，延续条件…在这种读法下说的正是这个，根上称之为续无外'. astra 4: '把不同时刻的影响合在一起来读、不要求各环节按时间先后衔接时（跨越所有步来读）', 不计时间 gone. astra 6 and H3: '生命是否会形成这种次序，尚未表明：在证明中它是假设；模型中的持存只是对所择者的过滤，并不形成次序（07 §4.9）'. astra 7: H4's Chinese. astra 9: the theorem's direction '只证明了这一个方向，反过来未证'; 单向 not used for it (nor anywhere on the page now). H2: '而按扩大排序，也不在生命自身的关切之外另加前提，因为关系闭合时，这一关切本身已经这样排序' (not 它不是第二个前提; joined by 而, not 所以, as in the English). H9: '这两项结果可以直接组合，只是没有一条定理单独陈述这一组合'. astra 10's small repair for 08 §8: '把排序结果所预设的范围与次序说清楚'. The template comment gains a dated seventh-pass note saying this, and that the sentences are not yet re-read by two Chinese readers.

for_ren: The first screen's ethics paragraph and its how-far sentences, in English and Chinese (_process/navigation/README-FIRST-SCREEN.md, README-ZH.md), the anchor every front follows. What changed from the sixth pass: the condition said as reach ('nothing lies outside each one's reach'), relations closing 'read across all steps'; widening as what 'every way of adding up worth that counts each thing above zero' ranks higher, with the theorem's additive form in the how-far clause; 'ranking by widening adds no premise beside the life's own concern: there, that concern already does it' in place of 'it is no second premise'; one way, concern for one's own continuation 'need not count' those who depend on one; and 'That a life forms such an order is not shown' in place of 'argued, not shown', what the models show of persisting being a filter on what was chosen, not an order formed (07 §4.9).

One change to the coordinator's anchor: 'and', not 'so', between 'every way of adding up worth... ranks the wider course higher' and 'ranking by widening adds no premise beside the life's own concern', since the reason it adds no premise is the self-concern theorem, not the weighting characterization.

The Chinese ethics paragraph defines self-concern once as a property of an order and says why, where relations close, it ranks every widening (everything lies within one's own reach); the English leaves this inside 'if a life holds its own continuation as an order over courses'.
